title: 접힌 선 위의 동그라미
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop acoustic ballad featuring a male and female vocal duet. The arrangement centers on a fingerpicked acoustic guitar playing steady eighth-note patterns. A clean electric guitar provides melodic counterpoint with subtle slides and vibrato. The tempo is 78 BPM in 4/4 time, likely in the key of G Major. The male vocal is a warm baritone, while the female vocal is a clear, airy soprano. Both voices utilize breathy delivery and gentle vibrato. The production is intimate with close-mic techniques and light hall reverb on the vocals.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerpicked acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
[male vocals]
서점에서 태어났다
누군가 나를 집었다
처음 펼쳐진 날 세상이 넓었다
손가락이 해안선을 따라
갔다
여기 가자
여기 도 가자
볼펜으로 동그라미를 쳤다
하나 둘 세 개의 약속이다

[Chorus]
[female vocals enter]
나는 지도다
길을 가진 책이다
기다린다
동그라미 안에서 [clean electric guitar melody enters]
